display_information.name: Turnpups MOS (Claude)
display_information.description: Daily 8 AM readout across leadership priorities, the ClickUp sprint and active Intelligems tests. Posts as Claude.
display_information.long_description:
Turnpups Management Operating System. Every weekday at 8:00 AM Central this bot posts a readout comparing yesterday's snapshot to this morning's: what is still Not Started, what is In Progress, what changed overnight, which tests moved, and which leadership priorities need attention.

Each flagged item carries an Ask for recommendation button. Clicking it runs the Strategic Advisor and posts a recommendation back into the thread.

Replying to a readout in the thread sends the feedback to the Learning Skill, which proposes a specific configuration change as a pull request and waits for approval. Nothing changes until the pull request is merged.

Every message this app posts identifies itself as Claude.
